name: v10.22.17 Europe evidence tranche 1D - ES, PT, IT, SI, HR
notes: Official-source evidence for Spain (ES), Portugal (PT), Italy (IT), Slovenia (SI) and Croatia (HR). All five endpoints were locally probed from the API container and returned HTTPS 200 responses with usable foreigner, immigration, residence, work or migration content. The tranche is intentionally limited to the narrow service functions described and does not claim complete immigration-law coverage. Submission creates pending proposals only; independent reviewer certification remains required.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs official portal
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, European Union and Cooperation operates exteriores.gob.es as the official portal for foreign affairs, consular services and information for foreigners. This supports a proposal that Spain directly administers the relevant foreigner and consular services through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
immigration_assessment.review_notes: Approved by coverage-evidence-reviewer. Official source probed and returned HTTPS 200 with relevant foreigner/immigration/residence content.

source_certification.evidence_notes: Locally probed on 2026-07-18 with status local_probe_passed. The Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs portal returned HTTPS 200 with content about foreign affairs, consular services and information for foreigners. Keep the initial certification limited to the consular and foreigner services explicitly described.
source_certification.review_notes: Approved by coverage-evidence-reviewer. Official source reachable and relevant to immigration/foreigner services.
